rationale.conceptual: The method consists of evaluating provided closed-form exponential formulas and performing a common Monte Carlo sampling with geometric overlap checks. While overlap detection for randomly oriented rectangles requires basic computational geometry (e.g., separating axis theorem), this is a standard library-level operation, not novel algorithm development.
rationale.execution: The pipeline is short: compute two theoretical CSVs (trivial), run one simulation script that produces two CSVs, and collect summary metrics. All steps are sequential and use only numpy/matplotlib; no external data fetching or complex environment setup is needed.
